thread:
maria: Heads-up — a mid-market customer hit a regression after last Optimize release where promptset-based evals didn't block a bad quantization combo. They want a patch prioritized: automatic presubmit evals + a safety rollback. Need to decide scope and launch criteria. :warning:
ajay: Can you paste the error/manifestation they saw?
maria: They reported generation quality drop on a reranking promptset — precision dropped ~18% vs baseline. Customer also runs Dedicated, so it's a config edge (mixed-quant + aggressive batching).
lauren: Oof. Is this a data/metrics regression only or does it fail any safety checks?
maria: Metrics only (quality/regression). No safety flags. They want a hotfix that makes presubmit evals fail fast for changes that affect customer promptsets by >5% absolute.
kevin: Quick thoughts: we can add a lightweight presubmit job that runs 3 representative promptsets (including their reranker) and a perf smoke test. Should be fast (<10m) if we cache model artifacts.
sara: How deterministic are these promptsets? If we run as part of CI we need seed control + stable sampling to avoid noise.
ajay: We should also consider an automatic fallback route in serving: if deployed model variant shows sudden drop in production eval metrics (rolling 30m), route to previous variant. That buys time while we hotfix.
lauren: For scope negotiation: minimal viable patch = (1) presubmit job configured for affected repos, (2) an on-call alert if presubmit fails, (3) rollback policy in the deployment pipeline. Anything else is nice-to-have.
maria: Agreed. Product ask: add acceptance criteria for the hotfix: presubmit runs within 15m, false-positive rate <3% over 1 week prod runs, automatic rollback triggers only when delta >5% and persists for 10m.
kevin: Implementation notes: we add a new GH Action 'optimize-evals-presubmit' that runs eval harness with seeded RNG and pinned model hashes. Snippet:
```
name: optimize-evals-presubmit
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v2
  - run: poetry install
  - run: python eval/harness.py --promptset rerankerA --seed 42 --model $MODEL_HASH
```
We can reuse existing eval infra.
sara: QA: need a test matrix: (deterministic seed x 3 promptsets x quantization profiles). That’s ~9 runs — should still fit 15m if we parallelize.
ajay: Ops: deploy-bot, can you schedule a canary policy change? We need a routing fallback at serving level and a rollout window small enough to detect regressions.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: rollout_percentages = [5, 20, 50] with metrics check at each step (generation_precision). If check fails, automatic revert to previous model.
lauren: Launch criteria checklist draft:
- Presubmit job added and green for 3 internal PRs
- Automated alerting wired to oncall
- Canary routing + automatic rollback verified in staging
- Runbook for oncall with next steps and customer comms template
- Post-deploy monitoring dashboard with promptset-level metrics
maria: Timeline: customer needs mitigation this week. Can we aim for a canary-ready patch in 4 working days?
kevin: I can push the GH Action and basic pipeline changes today, but staging canary + dashboard verification will take 3 days. So 4 days is tight but doable.
sara: I'll write QA cases and prep a small synthetic dataset they can run to reproduce locally.
ajay: Product/customer comms: maria, can you draft the customer message offering immediate mitigations (temporary throttling to previous model + ETA for hotfix)?
maria: On it. I'll propose temporary traffic shift to previous stable variant and ask for permission to run forced presubmit against their private promptset.
lauren: One more negotiation point: whether to make these presubmit checks mandatory for all model/quant changes or opt-in per repo. Mandatory would reduce risk but increase CI cost. Thoughts?
kevin: Start opt-in for now with a product rule: if a customer has an SLA or 'blocking promptset' flagged, enable presubmit. After 1 month of signals, consider rolling mandatory.
ajay: OK. Action owners:
- kevin: GH Action + pipeline rollback (owner)
- sara: QA test matrix + synthetic repro (owner)
- lauren: rollout policy + staging verification (owner)
- maria: customer comms + enablement (owner)
- ajay: post-deploy metric thresholds + rollback criteria (owner)
We'll reconvene in the #product standup in 24h. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks all — please add blockers to this thread. I'll update the customer after staging verification. :thumbsup:
